_comment: Shared app catalog for JBTheatreTools. Both the macOS (SwiftUI) and Windows (WinForms) launchers bundle this file and resolve the per-OS/arch asset by exact name. Keep in sync with each tool's release asset names. Platform keys: macos, windows-x64, windows-arm64 (plus optional per-arch macOS keys macos-arm64 / macos-x64, which the macOS launcher prefers over the universal `macos` key when present). macOS assets are .zip bundles containing a .app; Windows assets are self-contained single-file .exe. The `self` object describes JBTheatreTools' own releases, used for the launcher's self-update check. `downloadServer` is the built-in relay base URL for the default passphrase auth mode (the endpoint requires the suite passphrase; a user-invisible override exists in local settings if this URL ever moves). Seventeen apps (NDI Tools ships two variants — Standard and a batteries-included 'Full' with the NDI runtime bundled — chosen by a per-row toggle; each app entry may carry an optional `variants` array [{id,label,assets}], and the Full variant uses the per-arch macOS keys macos-arm64 / macos-x64); Each app entry may carry optional `whatsNew` + `whatsNewVersion` strings (a one-line what's-new for its current release, shown under the app in both launchers; omitted for apps with no release yet). asset names must match each tool's release assets exactly (an app with no published release yet simply shows 'No release' until its first build ships).

self.whatsNew: Downloads are now verified before they install.

apps.name: HELO Control
apps.blurb: Control AJA HELO stream / record encoders.
apps.whatsNew: Start/stop streaming from the app, and over OSC.

apps.name: Cisco Switch Tools
apps.blurb: Back up & manage Cisco CBS350 / SG switches over SSH.
apps.whatsNew: Custom output folders are now sanitised before writing.

apps.name: Cisco Brother Labels
apps.blurb: Generate Brother P-touch port labels from Cisco switch configs.
apps.whatsNew: Warns when labels are dropped or a file has none.

apps.name: Machine Inventory
apps.blurb: Collect hardware / software inventory from show machines.
apps.whatsNew: Maintenance and reliability release; no functional changes.

apps.name: Network Port Map
apps.blurb: Map network switch ports to the devices plugged into them.
apps.whatsNew: Maintenance and build-hardening release; no functional changes.

apps.name: Projector Control
apps.blurb: Control theatre projectors over PJLink (Panasonic / Epson).
apps.whatsNew: Switch a projector's input source from the app.

apps.name: Show Dashboard
apps.blurb: Generate a Node-RED show-control dashboard for a production.
apps.whatsNew: New L-Acoustics amp control, plus custom device groups.

apps.name: Show Handbook
apps.blurb: Generate a per-show video handbook document.
apps.whatsNew: Faster on large Bibles; won't close mid-generate.

apps.name: PSN Tools
apps.blurb: Monitor, visualise, generate & record PosiStageNet (PSN) tracking data.
apps.whatsNew: Change any setting while it's running — no restart.

apps.name: DMX Tools
apps.blurb: Monitor, generate & translate Art-Net + sACN lighting data.
apps.whatsNew: Edit settings live; fixed sACN→Art-Net translation.

apps.name: Desk Convert
apps.blurb: Convert digital mixing-console show files between manufacturers (DiGiCo ↔ Yamaha).
apps.whatsNew: Now writes Yamaha bus names; fixed a startup crash.

apps.name: NDI Tools
apps.blurb: Discover NDI video sources on the network and check their health & bandwidth.
apps.whatsNew: First release — discover NDI sources, health and bandwidth (not a viewer).

apps.name: PowerCalc
apps.blurb: Plan power distribution, balance the phases & print a load sheet.
apps.whatsNew: Banks of identical units now auto-balance across all three phases.

apps.name: Show Control Tools
apps.blurb: Monitor & translate OSC, MIDI and MSC show-control messages.
apps.whatsNew: First release — monitor and bridge OSC, MIDI and MSC.

apps.name: ShowNet Scanner
apps.blurb: Discover every device on a show network in one live inventory.
apps.whatsNew: First release — sweeps every show protocol into one live inventory.

apps.name: Timecode Tools
apps.blurb: Monitor, generate, convert & compare LTC, MTC and Art-Net timecode.
apps.whatsNew: Smooth frame-accurate readout; generate MTC with no cables.

apps.name: PDF Tools
apps.blurb: A private, offline PDF toolbox — merge, split, convert, redact and more.
apps.whatsNew: Chain several tools in one run; visual organise, crop, annotate, form-fill.
